description: This Java class 'TaskEvents' handles order processing related events such as completing assignments, accepting roles, delegating, and accepting assignments within the OFBiz framework. It interacts with services, event handlers, and request/response objects to facilitate workflow-related operations.

classes.name: TaskEvents
classes.description: This class contains static methods that handle various workflow-related tasks in the order management process within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: completeAssignment
methods.description: Handles the process of completing an assignment, invoking the 'wfCompleteAssignment' service, and managing errors related to date formatting and service invocation.

methods.name: acceptRoleAssignment
methods.description: Invokes the service to accept a role assignment within an order workflow, handling possible invocation errors.

methods.name: delegateAndAcceptAssignment
methods.description: Performs delegation and acceptance of an assignment by invoking the appropriate service, with error handling.

methods.name: addToOrderRole
methods.description: Adds a user to an order role via the 'addOrderRole' service, with error handling and success logging.
